from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Form from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse from jinja2 import Environment, BaseLoader import logging import os app = FastAPI(title="Internal Report Generator", version="2.1.0") logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) # Template environment for dynamic report generation jinja_env = Environment(loader=BaseLoader(), autoescape=False) # Internal configuration SERVICE_NAME = os.getenv("SERVICE_NAME", "report-gen") INTERNAL_API_KEY = os.getenv("INTERNAL_API_KEY", "") def validate_internal_request(request: Request) -> bool: """Basic validation for internal service mesh requests.""" api_key = request.headers.get("X-Internal-Key", "") if INTERNAL_API_KEY and api_key != INTERNAL_API_KEY: return False return True @app.get("/health") async def health(): return {"status": "healthy", "service": SERVICE_NAME} @app.post("/api/v1/render-report", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def render_report( request: Request, template_body: str = Form(...), report_title: str = Form(default="Untitled Report"), department: str = Form(default="Engineering"), ): """Render a custom report template with provided variables. This endpoint is used by the internal dashboard service to generate PDF-ready HTML reports from user-defined templates. Render Error
